title: Murderer’s ground.
html_source: This ends the section in the style of Horace Walpole, which began above with “But Malachias' tale.”

anchor.prefix: house by the graveyard is uninhabited. No soul will live there. The spider pitches her web in the solitude. The nocturnal rat peers from his hole. A curse is on it. It is haunted.
